origin.note: The walk added the type beside an existing page count; the fixture has none, so this case asks for both.

title: Show the file type next to the page count
objective: On the document page's meta line (data-testid="doc-meta"), show the page count and the file type, like "18 pages · PDF". Types: application/pdf is PDF, a Word document (.docx) is Word, an Excel sheet (.xlsx) is Excel, a PowerPoint deck (.pptx) is PowerPoint, anything else is File.
acceptance: d4 reads "4 pages · Word" and d2 reads "1 page · Excel"
A PowerPoint deck reads PowerPoint and an unknown type reads File
plan_summary: A typeLabel(mimeType) helper in format.mjs; render it beside the page count.
